name: Beam AI
tagline: Self-learning AI agents for enterprise operations.
description: Beam AI is an agentic process automation platform that turns written standard operating procedures into self-learning AI agents for back-office work. Agents handle data entry and extraction, document processing, and communication tasks across functions like finance, HR, and customer operations, integrating with existing enterprise systems. Beam targets mission-critical workflows where data privacy and deep integration matter, and reports production use at large enterprises.

modelSupport.notes: Agents are built on frontier LLMs; model choice is abstracted by the platform.

insight: Founded in 2022; a Y Combinator company also backed by Tiger Global Management and Uncorrelated Ventures.
edge: Turns a written SOP into a self-learning agent for back-office ops — built for deeply integrated enterprise workflows, not lightweight task automation.
